recommendation: Use a run-bound monotonic fence token plus exact-peer validation at the G3 transport submission boundary.
fence_protocol: State includes never-reset generation, binding_nonce, run identity/incarnation, mode, and reason.
close always increments generation and never waits for in-flight action; open requires the originally captured current token.
Admission locks only through ticket validation, permit issuance, and consumed/in-flight registration; action and ACK wait occur outside admission/coordinator/fence locks.
Ticket run/incarnation, admission active run/incarnation, and fence run/incarnation/token must all match.
Cancellation and failure results use close_if_binding on the captured nonce so stale run A cannot affect B.
transport_protocol: Extend G3 request with expected_peer or expected_peers and authority_token.
After acquiring the selected live peer write lock, validate current peer identity and token under the bridge condition immediately before pending registration.
Never retry or reselect a replacement peer after a bound request mismatch/failure.
Bound pause/resume and automatic OMP delivery use this API; arbitrary callback is local-admission-only and cannot claim exact-peer delivery.
lock_order: A/C/B may briefly consult F; F never calls A/C/B. External action, probe, mirror publication, transport write, and ACK wait are outside A/C/F locks.
scope: CW12 and existing G3 integration only; CW15 boundary unchanged
